extName.message: AutoSPD for YouTube — AI Smart Playback Speed

extDescription.message: Sets YouTube playback speed by video content: keywords, YouTube categories or on-device AI. Channel rules; live and music stay 1x.

popupSubtitle.message: AI smart playback speed for YouTube

autoSpeedHint.message: Set the speed from the video and your rules

hideCaptionsHint.message: Turn off captions YouTube switches on by itself

notificationsHint.message: Show the category and speed on the video when it changes

openYouTube.message: Open a YouTube video in this tab first

reloadTab.message: Reload the YouTube tab and try again

noVideoToControl.message: There's no YouTube video to control.

aiDownloadable.message: AI model not downloaded; download it in Settings

aiUnavailable.message: This computer can't run AI analysis

aiUnsupported.message: This Chrome version doesn't support AI analysis

statusNotVideo.message: This tab isn't a video page

captionsOn.message: Captions will be turned off on videos you open next

errCannotApply.message: Can't apply this speed right now

optionsIntro.message: Choose how videos are classified, then set a playback speed for each category.

modeKeywordsHint.message: Match the video's title, tags and channel against your categories and keywords, as specific as the content you watch. If nothing matches, the YouTube category's speed is used.

modeYouTubeHint.message: Use the YouTube category the uploader chose. Stable and unaffected by titles, but broad: most talk shows sit in Entertainment or People & Blogs.

modeAiHint.message: Chrome's built-in AI model (Gemini Nano, running on your computer; nothing is uploaded) works out what a video is really about, ignoring sensational titles, and picks one of your categories below. The video starts at the keyword speed and is corrected after a second or two. Each video is analyzed once.

keywordHelp.message: A category applies when the title, tags or channel contain one of its keywords, or its YouTube category matches. English keywords match whole words (TED won't match "tested"); other languages match text. Separate keywords with commas or new lines.

ytHintYouTubeMode.message: Each YouTube category has its own playback speed.

ytHintFallback.message: When a video matches none of the categories above, these speeds apply by its YouTube category.

defaultSpeedHint.message: Used when YouTube reports no category for a video.

errDefaultSpeed.message: Default speed must be between $arg1$ and $arg2$.

liveMusicHint.message: "Fixed 1x" beats every category and channel rule. You can still change the speed by hand.

fixedLiveHint.message: Videos that are live right now. Replays of finished streams aren't affected.

fixedMusicHint.message: YouTube's Music category, auto-generated "- Topic" channels, or titles and tags with terms like MV, Official Video, lyrics, concert, fancam or Inkigayo.

replayHint.message: Replays of finished streams are usually long. When no category matches, this speed applies before the YouTube category speed. Channel rules and categories still win.

channelRulesHint.message: Channel rules beat every category, except fixed 1x for live and music. Open the AutoSPD popup on a video page to set a speed for that channel.

errCategoryDuplicate.message: "$arg1$" is a duplicate; use a different name.

errCategorySpeed.message: Speed for "$arg1$" must be between $arg2$ and $arg3$.

errCategoryMatchers.message: "$arg1$" needs a keyword or a YouTube category, or it will never match a video.

errYtSpeed.message: Speed for YouTube category "$arg1$" must be between $arg2$ and $arg3$.

errChannelSpeed.message: Speed for channel "$arg1$" must be between $arg2$ and $arg3$.

errReplaySpeed.message: Live replay speed must be between $arg1$ and $arg2$.

aiNoChrome.message: This Chrome version doesn't support built-in AI. Update Chrome or use another method.

aiNeedsDownload.message: The AI model must be downloaded first (several GB, once only).

aiDownloadingWait.message: AI model downloading; it will be used when finished…

aiNoHardware.message: This computer doesn't meet Chrome's built-in AI requirements. Use another method.

confirmReset.message: Restore the default categories? Categories you added or edited will be cleared.

savedSummary.message: Saved $arg1$ categories and $arg2$ channel rules. Open YouTube tabs apply them right away.

errQuota.message: Categories exceed Chrome's sync storage limit. Remove some keywords or categories.
